clips.start_words: Certain food is designed to break down
clips.end_words: Animals in the wild don't have juice machines
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a reason eating an orange works better than drinking the juice: the fiber in the whole fruit slows everything down.

His point: that slower pace lets more of the vitamin C and bioflavonoids get absorbed in the intestine instead of the stomach. Skip the fiber and drink straight juice, he says, and more of it breaks down too fast - which can even leave you with extra stomach acid.

His line for it: animals in the wild don't have juice machines.

Fruit or juice - which do you reach for first?

#kevintrudeau #vitaminc #wbdaily #healthtruth #readthelabel #wholefood

clips.end_words: food that has flavor or taste anymore
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells a story about cooking pasta sauce with one clove of garlic that barely tasted like garlic at all, even though it was organic.

His explanation: our soil has been drained of nutrients by decades of the same crops grown on the same land, heavy chemical fertilization, and the 1930s Dust Bowl, when 12 feet of topsoil blew clean away across the country.

That topsoil held most of the minerals food is supposed to carry.

Kevin Trudeau's point: we don't produce food with real flavor anymore, because we don't produce food with real nutrients anymore. Ever notice vegetables don't taste like they used to?

#kevintrudeau #foodtruth #soilhealth #wbdaily #healthtruth #realfood
